purpose: SDM native Android tutorial design for user approval

boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity product design approval board for SDM's NATIVE ANDROID guided tutorial, not a web dashboard. Wide landscape, high resolution, four equally sized portrait Android screens in a single row, full screens visible, no overlapping devices, minimal outer bezels, generous gutters. Plain warm-black board background. Native 412x915 logical screen proportions, very crisp large readable English UI text. Board heading top left and four short panel captions above screens.
Existing SDM design is strict: background #070707, card #121315, elevated sheet #191a1c, thin border #2d2c28, primary gold #D4AF37, high gold #F3D675, warm text #F5F1E8, muted #9A978F, success #70c69b, danger #ef756b. Avenir Next heavy titles, IBM Plex Sans body. 16/20px rounded cards, 24px sheet radius, 16px spacing, 44px minimum buttons. Small outlined rounded-square SD monogram beside screen title. Native bottom pill navigation with FIVE items: Downloads, Browser, elevated circular gold + Add, Files, Settings. Native app screens, NOT sidebar or desktop tables. Thin consistent outline icons, custom gold checkboxes. Do not introduce Premium upsell or external media auto detection.
Tutorial system: keep native app visible under 65% black scrim; one real target control at a time inside a precisely bounded 2px warm-gold rounded spotlight, no neon/glow, no cartoon arrows. Floating charcoal coach card attached to target with short triangular pointer, modest gold chapter eyebrow, heading, exactly ONE or TWO short lines, local chapter progress indicator; footer shows Back (outlined) Next (solid gold) and unobtrusive Skip. Cards never obscure highlighted target, status bar, bottom navigation or keyboard. When example data are visible label them discreetly "Tutorial sample". No actual user's filenames. No real network or file mutation; tutorial examples are isolated. Across all four phones keep typography, target outline, overlay density and button placement consistent. No visual decoration, 3D render, gradients, real photography or Android Material blue defaults. All copy English, faithfully spelled and legible.
Board title: "SDM / Guided tour". Subtitle: "01 — Start & downloads". Four screens:
1 "Welcome": no scrim, native Downloads behind a compact centered onboarding sheet with SD monogram, heading "Get to know SDM", body "A quick hands-on tour with safe sample downloads.", a tidy six-item chapter list Downloads / Details / Torrents / Browser / Files / Settings, footer "Not now" and gold "Start tour". Calm and compact.
2 "Find your downloads": native Downloads home with four compact summary values (2 active, 3.8 MB/s, 1.2 GB left, 16 connections), All / Queue / Completed tabs, two sample download cards, bottom nav. Spotlight just the three filter tabs. Coach BELOW spotlight, eyebrow "DOWNLOADS · 1 / 5", title "Everything in one place", text "Switch between all downloads, your queue and completed files.", 5 small progress marks with first gold, Back/Next/Skip.
3 "Add a link": native Add download bottom sheet, multiline URL field https://example.com/sample.zip, Paste button, destination Download/SDM, Queue / Start now radio. Spotlight multiline field plus Paste, coach above keyboard-free visible field. Eyebrow "DOWNLOADS · 2 / 5", title "Paste one link or several", text "Add one link per line. Review the destination before starting.", Back/Next/Skip.
4 "Manage your queue": Downloads Queue with three compact sample cards, grip icons on LEFT and two gold checkboxes selected on RIGHT, selected group action bar. Spotlight only the drag grip/selected-card group, coach above cards or in free lower area without covering grips, eyebrow "DOWNLOADS · 5 / 5", title "Put important files first", text "Drag a file or selected group to change queue order.", Back/Next/Skip.

Board title "SDM / Guided tour". Subtitle "02 — Details & torrents". Four screens matching exactly the tutorial overlay system of board 01:
1 "Understand progress": native Download details for "Sample archive.zip", 42% circular gold progress ring, two metric cards connections/time, gold speed history line, Pause and Cancel row. Spotlight just the history chart (not the whole app); coach in blank lower region, eyebrow "DETAILS · 1 / 7", heading "See how your download is doing", text "Track speed, progress and the active connections.", Back / Next / Skip.
2 "Set a schedule": native schedule bottom sheet on download details: Any time / Scheduled / Daily window radio choices, custom dark-gold time selector at 01:00 AM and 07:00 AM, phone time zone text. Spotlight file selection area only, coach above or below it, "TORRENTS · 2 / 4", heading "Download only what you need", text "Choose files before adding the torrent to your queue.", Back / Next / Skip.
All panel progress indicators use exactly the right count: DETAILS seven segments with completed/current gold and future gray; TORRENTS four segments. Flat matte gold buttons.
boards.revision: Edit ONLY these text/value mistakes in this existing SDM tutorial board, preserve all four screens, layout, graphics, typography, spacing and other wording. In phone 1, under Connections change "8 peers" to exactly "8"; change chart x-axis from minutes to last 60 seconds with labels "60s", "48s", "36s", "24s", "12s", "Now". In phone 2 replace "Time zone: Eastern Time (ET)" with exactly "Phone time zone: Asia/Tehran". In phone 3 step 7/7 indicator must have seven completed GOLD marks and zero gray. In phone 4 the optional "Start seeding after download" toggle must be OFF (gray track, thumb left). Do not add or remove any controls or screens. Return same entire four-screen landscape board, not a crop.
